description: 泱穹 Agent Harness 是一套用纯 Java 构建的企业级 AI Agent 运行时框架，ReAct 循环、六大范式、子代理编排、持久化执行、安全护栏、全链路可观测，零 Spring 依赖。Enterprise-grade AI Agent runtime framework in pure Java — ReAct loop, 6 paradigms, sub-agent orchestration, durable execution, guardrails, observability. No Spring required.
